risk_note: RV2 (B2-05u; orchestrator D10-3358 ②, D10-3401, D10-3458, D10-3490; BR-WDR-02 细则, BR-WDR-03, BR-WDR-07 ④). BR-WDR-02: once an app closes a payout method (withdraw.payout_methods), a member bound to that method gets 30305 on submitting a withdrawal ("counts as no usable payout account"); withdrawals already created are not affected. The binding half was on main; this task adds the withdrawal half. readWithdrawInput (payout/application/withdraw-rules.ts) reads the open set and, when the current account's method is not in it, hands the rule chain payout_method null: step ⑤ gives 30305 on both GET /v1/withdrawals/rules and POST /v1/withdrawals, the maximum is computed as unbound; the blocklist judgement, the payee's daily counts, the name comparison and the locks keep the real account, and the order of the checks is unchanged. Under the locks the submission refuses 30305 as well when the method was closed after the first pass (withdraw-apply.ts, before the locked re-check; BR-WDR-07 ④ re-runs ⑤ under the locks). The parser and the default set {alipay, bank_card} stay one copy in identity and are handed to payout by app.module as an optional structural port (payout imports nothing of identity, 规划/02 §4.1); without the port — hand-built test assemblies only — the switch is not read and the behaviour is main's; the rule tests run through the real AppModule. A missing config row is the default; an invalid value is the default with a warning. Review, batching, automatic payout, payout and retry code is untouched; the pure rule functions (payout/domain) are untouched. No migration. Contract: wording only — the meaning and sources of 30305 in error-codes.yaml and one sentence in each of the two withdrawal operations of openapi.yaml, generated files regenerated; no shape, code or enum changes (contract slot held by this task, released at merge). No amount is computed differently and no voucher is written by a new path: a refused submission creates no withdrawal and freezes nothing. Pinned by the implementer's unit tests only, to become rule tests after this PR (FU-B2-05U-SPEC-EXISTING-AND-MISSING-ROW): the missing config row, no other payout code path reading the switch, and the closed-after-the-first-pass refusal under the locks. Open follow-ups: FU-WDR-PAYOUT-METHODS-CONFIG-SERIALIZE (the S2 of money review r2), FU-WDR-LOCKED-RECHECK-56 (the other gaps of the locked re-check, orchestrator D10-3494, a task of its own), FU-WDR-CLOSED-METHOD-HINT (a dedicated message, after launch). The sharded run was made on base c962cbfe6d16; when this evidence was built main had gained 3 more commit(s): f4ee0b9fe test(spec): B1-08zzd 规则测试（Codex 写测 1） (#946); 22ca1c123 F1-01y：后台加 tiptap 3.31.4（core、pm、starter-kit、extension-image、react），供协议版本页正文编辑与只读显示 (#951); 439e3b9db test(spec): B1-08zzf 拼多多冻结夹具补 lk 与 links 行（74 块，块内补业务信息，断言与金额不动；新增 test/spec/orders/pdd-link-fixture. They change code outside the ledger: apps/admin/package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, test/spec/commission/**, test/spec/orders/**, test/spec/settlement/** (29 file(s)); none of these files is changed by this task (no path in common, the rebase is conflict-free). The landed head is rebased over them and that combination was NOT re-run on the test machine (orchestrator D10-3563); the required CI checks, verify-int included, run on the PR head.
